decisions_where_design_silent: Late sentence: the design's 'so I did the safe read' uses 'safe', a banned word in her templates (mind_words.BANNED), so it reads '4 were late, so I did what I do without it.'

The no-model sentence is given exactly when local_brain cannot be imported; with local_brain present but no turns, she says 'I asked the model nothing this week. Everything I did, I did without it.' (no false 'No model').

Help = a used outcome (TAKEN/TRIMMED/UNSETTLED) whose value differs from the kind's fallback value, or whose fallback is ASK_OWNER (she did not ask you). turns.ask now also computes the fallback for used turns to know this. 'Changed' is split: ASK_OWNER -> fewer questions; wording -> worded; reading switch -> places; choosing -> choices of next step; else readings of your words. Parts beyond three go in a second sentence 'And ...' to stay under 30 words.

Talk turns are counted apart ('You also talked with it ...'), not as her questions, and not in the wait. Wait = foreground turns' elapsed, each capped at its deadline. Held memory (GB x hours) and the 'last 50 requests' understanding tally are not built: neither is in the ledger, and neither is in A4's acceptance examples.

Honest null: per turn kind, >= 20 non-failed turns in the last 30 days (the ledger bound) after any ask_again, none differing. ORDER (the tripwire) and TALK are never stopped. The stop is real: request_for reads stopped kinds once per request and ask() gives NOT_SENT/NO_HELP. Switch back = brain.help.set ask_again (with Undo), shown as 'Ask it again' in the Brain room.

Secrets: the structural net is the doorway's own SECRET_SHAPED detector (doorway._secrets), applied in turns.layout (messages 2 and 4), over every string of a stored record, in local_brain.completion, run_reply and slate_stream.complete. Consequence: any 13-19 digit Luhn-valid number in a prompt is withheld, as the doorway already does for pages.

A new mark RAW ("the model's answer, exactly as it gave it") for the raw answer inside the fold; a check detail, reason or second view that echoes the model's answer (a token of 4+ characters) is shown model-marked under her line, not as her words.
Forget's tombstone keeps switch, differs, without and deadline_ms (counts, never words) so the account is unchanged by Forget.
brain.account and brain.turn.forget live in model_account.py (A4's file) rather than turns.py's FIELDS, to keep the E0 module's edits small.
